propositions: Load-time mapping config errors (non-integer hierarchy, malformed axis/vocabulary block) must be caught and surfaced as error findings with MappingConfigError detail verbatim
Resolve-time mapping config errors (out-of-vocabulary values, unmapped-non-skipped entries) must be detected per-project-key via provider-neutral config resolvers and surfaced as error findings
All-empty projects.<KEY> blocks must be surfaced as warning findings (not errors) to flag likely stubs

Live drift detection must degrade gracefully when jira-datacenter extra is absent, PAT is unset, settings resolution fails, or probe transport times out — emitting a single unavailable finding with reason and zero exit
Live drift detection must identify configured-vs-observed divergences on status, type, and link axes via the mapping_probe.build_probe reader, excluding hierarchy (unobservable on Data Center)

Mapping diagnostics must run offline (always, stdlib-only) for internal validation, and best-effort (guarded, lazy Jira import) for live drift, with findings in a separate list kept out of run_repair iteration
